title: Dental PPO Plans Desk Guide: Reprocessing Lines Denied for the Initial Waiting Period
content:
Under the Dental PPO Plans, a claim line that stands denied for the waiting period counted from the coverage effective date, on an enrollment whose plan has never changed (no plan change date is recorded), may be reprocessed on the person's earlier coverage. The initial-wait reprocessing rule fixes the corrected patient share of such a line, and the correction is booked as a new decision that replaces the denial.

## When the rule is used
- **The line under reprocessing** is the enrollment's most recently decided line whose decision is a denial carrying the waiting-period denial remark. Where several such lines share that latest decision date, this rule is not used and each is reprocessed under the base rules. Where the enrollment shows a plan change date, this rule is not used.
- **Lines reprocessed under the base rules instead:** a line of an enrollment whose plan has changed; a line that a frequency or age limit would deny; a line of a child whose subscriber has two or more children enrolled on individual exchange enrollments; and a line on an account with more than three enrolled persons.
- **What the corrected decision keeps:** the denied line's claim number, line number, practice, network status, procedure, service class, tooth, extraction date, dates, benefit year, billed amount, allowed amount, alternate allowance and other-carrier payment.

## The booking tool: `reprocess_wait_denial_e5c18a2f`
**Capability.** Reprocesses one Dental PPO claim line that stands denied for a waiting period counted from the enrollment's coverage effective date. It books a corrected decision that replaces the denial, carrying over the denied line's claim number, line number, practice, network status, procedure, tooth, extraction date, dates of service and receipt, benefit year, billed, allowed and alternate allowances and other-carrier payment, and records the corrected deductible, coinsurance, total plan payment and patient share with the reprocessed remark (ADJUSTED_REPROCESSED) and today's decision date. In the same write any deductible taken is posted to the person's deductible, the payment or patient share is posted to the accumulator named by the accumulator track, and on the annual-maximum track any part of the payment funded from rollover dollars is drawn from the rollover balance instead of being posted to the annual maximum. Afterwards the member's Explanation of Benefits shows the corrected decision and the accumulators reflect it.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reprocess_wait_denial_e5c18a2f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `denied_claim_line_id` | Reference number of the denied claim-line decision being replaced, as returned by the dental claim-line lookup for the member's enrollment | Identifier |
| `deductible_applied` | Deductible taken on the corrected decision | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when no deductible is taken |
| `coinsurance_pct` | Coinsurance percentage the corrected decision pays at | Whole number from 0 to 100 |
| `plan_paid` | Corrected total plan payment for the line | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up; 0.00 when nothing is paid |
| `rollover_amount` | Part of the corrected plan payment funded from the person's rollover balance | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up; 0.00 when no rollover dollars are used |
| `member_responsibility` | Corrected patient share for the line | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up |
| `accumulator_track` | Accumulator the corrected decision posts to, besides any deductible taken | One of the three values below |

`accumulator_track` values:
- `annual_maximum` — the plan payment counts against the person's annual maximum;
- `pediatric_in_network` — the person receives the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment and the line is from an in-network practice, so nothing is posted to the annual maximum and the patient share is posted to the pediatric out-of-pocket accumulator;
- `pediatric_out_of_network` — the person receives that treatment and the line is from an out-of-network practice, so nothing is posted to either.

**Return.** On success, a text record with: `status` ("reprocessed"), `dental_claim_line_id` (reference number of the new corrected decision), `original_claim_line_id` (the denial replaced), `plan_paid`, `rollover_amount` and `member_responsibility` (USD, 2 decimals), `accumulator_track` (as booked) and `adjudicated_date` (decision date of the correction, YYYY-MM-DD).
